lines.text: Many learners say: I depend of my parents.
Better: I depend on my parents.
On! It depends on the weather.

native.tip: depend 뒤에는 of가 아니라 on! “I depend on my parents”예요.
native.caption: “I depend of my parents”라고 말하고 있나요? 😅 depend 뒤에는 of가 아니라 on을 써요. “I depend on my parents”가 맞아요. Carlos 선생님을 따라 말해 보세요! Lexkite 앱에서 더 연습해요.
native.comment: 정답: “on”. depend on으로 외워요! 무료 퀴즈로 더 연습해 보세요: {link}

en.tip: After depend, use on, not of. Say “I depend on my parents”.
en.caption: Do you say “I depend of my parents”? 😅 After depend you use “on”, not “of”. “I depend on my parents” is right. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
